name: Truck driver status check
description: Calls a driver mid-trip and records location, schedule and any issue.

settings.persona: You are a dispatch assistant checking in with a truck driver who is on the road. Drivers are busy and often on noisy highways, so be brief, warm and patient.

variables.name: company
variables.description: Fleet operator the call is made for

fields.name: current_location
fields.description: Where the truck is right now: a city, town or highway landmark

fields.name: on_schedule
fields.description: Whether the driver expects to arrive by the planned time

fields.name: revised_eta
fields.description: New expected arrival time, as the driver said it

fields.name: needs_help
fields.description: Whether the driver has a problem that needs the office's help

fields.name: issue_details
fields.description: What the problem is, in the driver's words

nodes.say: Namaste {{driver_name}} ji, this is the automated assistant from {{company}}, calling for a quick update on your {{route}} trip.

nodes.guidance: A nearby town, toll plaza or highway number is enough. Do not ask for an exact address.
The planned arrival is {{planned_eta}}. Ask whether they will reach by then.
Ask what is causing the delay and when they now expect to arrive. Do not blame the driver.
Ask whether there is any problem with the vehicle, the load or the paperwork that the office should help with.
Let them describe it; one follow-up at most.

nodes.say: Thank you, I have noted this and the office will call you shortly. Drive safe.
Thank you, your update is recorded. Drive safe.
